breaks.quote: Two lessons, 10 years apart. Most of us only ever learn the first one.
breaks.why: The writer stops the story to describe its own shape (two lessons, years apart) instead of letting the reader see it.

breaks.quote: That is why there is a chimpanzee in my notes.
breaks.why: It explains the piece's own design and why the story was chosen, which pulls the reader out of the point.
